CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_financial_profiles (
    user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
        REFERENCES users(user_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    current_age INTEGER
        CHECK (
            current_age IS NULL
            OR current_age BETWEEN 18 AND 120
        ),

    current_portfolio_value NUMERIC(20,2)
        NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        CHECK (current_portfolio_value >= 0),

    monthly_investment NUMERIC(20,2)
        NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        CHECK (monthly_investment >= 0),

    risk_tolerance TEXT
        CHECK (
            risk_tolerance IN (
                'conservative',
                'moderate',
                'aggressive'
            )
        ),

    preferred_sectors TEXT[]
        NOT NULL DEFAULT ARRAY[]::TEXT[],

    excluded_sectors TEXT[]
        NOT NULL DEFAULT ARRAY[]::TEXT[],

    inflation_rate NUMERIC(10,6)
        NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.025,

    pre_retirement_return NUMERIC(10,6)
        NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.060,

    withdrawal_rate NUMERIC(10,6)
        NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.040,

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ
        NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS financial_goals (
    goal_id UUID PRIMARY KEY
        DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),

    user_id TEXT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES users(user_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    goal_type TEXT NOT NULL
        DEFAULT 'retirement',

    retirement_age INTEGER
        CHECK (
            retirement_age IS NULL
            OR retirement_age BETWEEN 18 AND 120
        ),

    target_monthly_income_today NUMERIC(20,2)
        NOT NULL
        CHECK (target_monthly_income_today >= 0),

    other_monthly_income_today NUMERIC(20,2)
        NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        CHECK (other_monthly_income_today >= 0),

    status TEXT NOT NULL
        DEFAULT 'active'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'active',
                'completed',
                'paused',
                'cancelled'
            )
        ),

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ
        NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ
        NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS portfolio_holdings (
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES users(user_id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    ticker TEXT NOT NULL,

    quantity NUMERIC(20,6)
        NOT NULL
        CHECK (quantity > 0),

    average_cost NUMERIC(20,6)
        CHECK (
            average_cost IS NULL
            OR average_cost >= 0
        ),

    current_price NUMERIC(20,6)
        CHECK (
            current_price IS NULL
            OR current_price >= 0
        ),

    sector TEXT,

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ
        NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    PRIMARY KEY (
        user_id,
        ticker
    )
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS source_documents (
    document_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

    ticker TEXT NOT NULL,
    company_name TEXT,
    cik TEXT NOT NULL,
    form_type TEXT NOT NULL,

    filing_date DATE,
    report_date DATE,

    accession_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    source_url TEXT NOT NULL,

    pinecone_namespace TEXT
        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sec-filings',

    ingestion_status TEXT
        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
        CHECK (
            ingestion_status IN (
                'pending',
                'processing',
                'complete',
                'failed',
                'skipped'
            )
        ),

    chunk_count INTEGER
        NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        CHECK (chunk_count >= 0),

    error_message TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ
        NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    ingested_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ
        NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_source_documents_lookup
    ON source_documents (
        ticker,
        form_type,
        filing_date DESC
    );
